name: French Connection. ~Inran Onna Renzoku Seikou~
source:
Main character regains freedom after sentence in jail for female assault. He craves for violating women as if he is possessed by evil spirit. So he takes a camera to take shameful photos and sets off in search of a new victim.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/02/vn-of-month-april-2006-tenshitsuki-no.html]vndbreview[/url]]
